schema.description: 将音频转换为另一种封装与编码配置，并可调整采样率、码率、声道和响度，以及保留、新增或覆盖元信息，用于适配播放终端、网络传输和媒资库响度标准化。

input_schema.description: 可选参数仅在用户明确指定，或可从用户意图准确确定时填写；不得伪造。不能准确确定时省略，确为正确完成任务所必需时先向用户澄清。

audio.description: audio 提供音频参数配置。

bitrate_kbps.description: bitrate_kbps 指定音频码率，单位为 Kbps，范围 10 至 500，默认值为 128。
bitrate_kbps.x-description-en: The audio bitrate in Kbps. Supported values range from a minimum of 10 to a maximum of 500, and it defaults to 128.

bitrate_mode.description: bitrate_mode 指定音频码率控制模式，支持 cbr 和 cae，默认 cbr。cbr 是恒定码率模式，编码器会尝试让音频流每秒严格保持 bitrate_kbps 设定的码率，使文件大小可以被精确预测，适合带宽稳定性要求高的流式传输。cae 仅在 container_format 为 M4A 时支持，会根据音频内容复杂度动态调整瞬时码率，并确保整个文件平均码率接近 bitrate_kbps 目标值。
bitrate_mode.x-description-en: Controls the audio bitrate mode. Supported values are cbr and cae, and the mode defaults to cbr. In cbr mode, the encoder tries to keep every second of the audio stream strictly at bitrate_kbps, making file size precisely predictable, so cbr is suitable for streaming scenarios with high bandwidth-stability requirements. In cae mode, the encoder dynamically adjusts instantaneous bitrate based on content complexity while ensuring the overall average bitrate approaches bitrate_kbps. cae is supported only when container_format is M4A.

channels.description: channels 指定音频声道数，支持 1 和 2；1 表示单声道，2 表示双声道。不传时不在客户端补默认值，由后端按源音频与任务配置处理。
channels.x-description-en: Specifies the number of audio channels. Supported values are 1 for Mono and 2 for Stereo. When omitted, the client does not send a default value and the backend handles it according to the source audio and task configuration.

sample_rate.x-description-en: Specifies the audio sample rate in Hz, and it defaults to 48000. Filling this field according to the target encoder is recommended. MP3 supports sample rates 8000, 11025, 12000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, and 48000. AAC supports sample rates 8000, 11025, 12000, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 64000, 88200, and 96000. Opus supports sample rate 48000.

volume_integrated_loudness.description: volume_integrated_loudness 用于设定音频整体感知音量的目标综合响度，单位为 LUFS，范围 -70 至 -5，默认值为 -12。
volume_integrated_loudness.x-description-en: Sets the overall perceived audio volume in LUFS. The minimum value is -70 and the maximum value is -5, with a default of -12. This field is optional.

volume_loudness_range.description: volume_loudness_range 调节音频最响亮和最安静部分之间的差异，单位为 LU，范围 1 至 20，默认值为 7；volume_method 为 2Pass 时生效。
volume_loudness_range.x-description-en: Adjusts the difference between the loudest and quietest audio parts, measured in LU. The minimum value is 1 and the maximum value is 20, with a default of 7. This field is optional and takes effect when volume_method is set to 2Pass.

volume_method.description: volume_method 是音量均衡算法开关；不设置时不处理音量。支持将 volume_method 设置为 2Pass 启用两阶段响度分析与处理，此时 volume_integrated_loudness、volume_true_peak 和 volume_loudness_range 生效。
volume_method.x-description-en: Controls loudness normalization for the audio, and is optional. If it is not set, the volume is not processed. Setting it to 2Pass enables two-pass loudness analysis and processing, and the integrated loudness, true peak, and loudness range settings then take effect.

volume_true_peak.description: volume_true_peak 设置音频信号的真实峰值最高上限，以防止削波失真，单位为 dBTP，范围 -9 至 0，默认值为 0。
volume_true_peak.x-description-en: Sets the maximum audio signal limit to prevent clipping distortion, in dBTP. This field is optional and defaults to 0, which is also the maximum allowed value. The minimum is -9.

audio_url.description: audio_url 是待转码音频的 URL，支持本地文件路径和公网 HTTP/HTTPS URL 两种输入协议；输入支持 mp3、m4a、wav、wma、amr、aac、ogg、flac 等音频格式。
audio_url.x-description-en: The URL of the audio to be transcoded. This field is required, and only publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URLs are supported as the file source. Supported input formats include mainstream audio formats such as mp3, m4a, wav, wma, amr, aac, ogg, and flac.

client_token.description: 用户请求凭证，用于幂等控制；大小写敏感，长度不超过 64 个 ASCII 可打印字符。 用于控制异步任务幂等；同步任务不支持幂等校验。异步任务首次提交时默认不传，服务端仍会对相同核心参数执行 24 小时默认幂等。用户明确指定 token 时原样使用。因网络超时、响应丢失等原因重试同一次提交时，原请求有 token 则复用原值，原请求未传则继续不传。任务已有结果后，用户要求“结果不对，重试”“重新跑一次”或“重新发起任务”时，必须生成并传递新的 token，避免返回原任务。新对话中用户要求“重新发起任务”时，若当前上下文具备完整任务参数，直接生成新 token 并提交；若参数不足，先向用户澄清，补齐后再使用新 token 发起，不得直接省略 token。新任务后续发生提交重试时复用该新 token。已有 task_id 且任务尚未完成时，只查询原任务，不得重新提交。CLI runtime 不判断用户意图，也不自动生成 token。

container_format.description: container_format 指定目标封装格式，建议填写，默认 MP3；系统根据封装格式自动选择对应编码器：MP3 封装格式使用 MP3 编码器，M4A 封装格式使用 AAC 编码器，OGG 封装格式使用 Opus 编码器。
container_format.x-description-en: Specifies the target container format. Specifying this field is recommended, and it defaults to MP3. Supported container formats are MP3, M4A, and OGG. The system selects the MP3 encoder for MP3, the AAC encoder for M4A, and the Opus encoder for OGG.

metadata_add_tags.description: metadata_add_tags 指定为输出音频新增的元信息标签；新增标签与保留标签同名时，新增标签设置覆盖源文件的值。

key.description: metadata_add_tags 中每个标签由 key 组成。
key.x-description-en: The key of a metadata tag.

value.description: metadata_add_tags 中每个标签由 value 组成。
value.x-description-en: The value of a metadata tag.

metadata_add_tags.x-description-en: An optional Array of Objects specifying the metadata tags to add to the output audio.

metadata_keep_tags.description: metadata_keep_tags 指定从源音频保留的元信息标签键；默认情况下，转码会丢弃大部分元信息，例如标题和艺术家。
metadata_keep_tags.x-description-en: An optional list of metadata tag keys to keep from the source audio, given as an Array of Strings. By default, transcoding discards most metadata, such as title and artist.

schema.name: transcode_audio

output_schema.description: Cloud 异步调用的提交结果。

request_id.description: 请求标识；仅在后端返回时出现。

task_id.description: 异步任务的唯一标识，用于查询任务状态并获取最终结果。

task_type.description: 任务类型；仅在后端实际返回非空值时出现。
